subtitle: Chicken soup
verso: For the flu and for heartbreak, a little soup is the best thing you can make.
story: The soup for colds, for heartbreak and for Sundays. Grandma used an old laying hen, which has more flavor than a young chicken. The broth should be clear and golden.

ingredients.title: The broth
items: 1 whole chicken (or stewing hen), cut in pieces, skin on

ingredients.title: To serve
items: Limes, chopped onion and cilantro, serrano

steps: Put the chicken, onion, garlic, tomato and celery in a pot with the water. Bring to a boil and skim well.
Add the salt and simmer gently 40 minutes (1½–2 hours for a hen). Keep it at a lazy bubble so the broth stays clear.
Remove the tomato and onion. Add the carrots and potatoes and cook 10 minutes. Add the chayote, zucchini and chickpeas and cook 8 minutes.
Add the cilantro off the heat. Serve with lime, onion, chile, avocado and rice.

pressureCooker.time: 15 min high pressure + 10 min natural release
steps: Put the chicken, aromatics, salt and [[2½ quarts]] water in the pot. High pressure 15 minutes (30 for a hen), natural release 10.
Remove the aromatics. Add the carrots, potatoes and chayote. High pressure 2 minutes, quick release.
On Sauté, add the zucchini and chickpeas for 4 minutes. Finish with cilantro.

tips: Once the foam is skimmed, never let it boil hard or the broth turns cloudy.
Add a handful of rice or fideo to the pot for a heartier soup.

variations.name: Caldo Tlalpeño
variations.subtitle: Smoky chipotle chicken soup
variations.note: A chipotle chicken soup named for Tlalpan, in the south of the capital. Local legend says it was made for Santa Anna as a hangover cure, and Tlalpan still holds a Festival del Caldo Tlalpeño.

items: Broth and shredded chicken from the base
2 chipotles en adobo (or 2 dried chipotles, toasted and soaked)
2 Roma tomatoes, ¼ onion, 1 garlic clove
2 carrots, diced, and ½ lb green beans, cut
To serve: avocado, cubes of queso panela or Oaxaca, lime

steps: Shred the chicken from the base, discarding the skin and bones. Blend the tomatoes, onion, garlic and chipotle with a cup of broth and fry in the oil 5 minutes.
Add to the broth with the carrots and chickpeas and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the green beans, epazote and shredded chicken and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve over cubes of cheese and avocado, with lime.
variations.pressureNote: Use the base pressure steps and add the chipotle sauce with the carrots.
